tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅: slob dpon pad+mas mdzad pa'i rgyud sde bzhi'i yang snying: bde gshegs zhi khro'i snying khrag gcig tu bsdus pa mtshon srung rdo rje'i go khrab kun thub srung ba'i rgyal po'i bri rgyun zab pa'i mthar thug bzhugs so:

ྈྈྈྈྈྈ sprul pa'i sku ste sku yi mchog: 'gro ba'i mgon po bla na med: yid bzhin nor bu re skong ba: rdo rje thod phreng rtsal la 'dud: slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas dang: 'khor los sgyur rgyal khri srong lde btsan dang: sprul pa'i mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal dang: legs pa'i dpal 'dzin 'bro bza' byang chub dang: bsod nams bsags pa'i pho yong rgyal btsun dang: sbyangs pa'i stobs ldan bai ro tsa na dang: tshul khrims ldan pa nam mkha'i snying po dang: brtul zhugs ldan pa ka ba dpal rtsegs dang: bsod nams ldan pa klu yi rgyal mtshan dang: pad+ma la gus dge slong rin mchog dang: 'bri yig mgyogs pa ldan ma rtse mang dang: gus par 'bri ba a tsar ye snang dang: sgra dbyangs mgyogs pa bdun pa rgyal mchog dang: rigs rgyud ldan pa mu tig btsan po dang: bsod nams stobs ldan mu tig khri lde dang: blo gros 'dzin pa bsod nams shes rab dang: dpa' rtsal stobs ldan rdo rje sprel chung dang: yig tshang legs 'dzin khri rje yab lhag dang: don kun grub pa'i ye shes rgyal po sogs: bsod nams bsags pa'i bod 'bangs mang po dang: dkar po'i phyogs kyi lha klu bsam 'das pas: brag dmar dpal gyi bsam yas lhun grub tu: gser g.yu mu tig dngul zangs rin chen khri: dar zab man tri yid 'ong mdzes pa'i gdan: za 'og gur phub 'ja' ltar bkra ba ru: yid bzhin nor bu pad+ma 'byung gnas bzhugs: ye shes mkha' 'gro de yi mdun du bzhugs: mnga' bdag rgyal po mdun du gus pas gnas: sgra bsgyur lo tsā g.yas rol mgo nas 'dug: gser dngul mu men maṇ+ḍal g.yu yis brgyan: phyi nang mchod pa mdangs ldan yid 'ong dang: gzi mchong nal skyogs rgun 'brum 'bras la sogs: bdud rtsis legs bkang gu ru rje la drangs: phyag 'tshal gsol btab bsang ba dpag med byas: rtse gcig mos pas gser sogs me tog 'thor: lha klu kun gyis me tog char pa dang:

sgra 'od 'ja' gur yid tsam sa yang g.yos: dus der lhun grub dpal gyi bsam yas su: phyi nang theg pa mchog gi rim pa dang: khyad par yongs rdzogs rta mgrin rgyud rnams dang: rdzogs chen gser zhun zhal gdams brgya rtsa gsungs: rgyal blon 'khor bcas lha klu la sogs kun: tshe 'di nyid la bde ba can du phyin: bya ba byed med 'gro don lhun gyis grub: ci bsam ma lus don kun dus der 'grub: rje 'bangs mgrin gcig 'dun pa drag po yis: mchod pa phul nas rje la 'di skad zhus: bdag cag 'dir 'dus don chen bsam pa 'grub: bdag gi bod khams ma rungs blun po'i yul: kha ba can 'dir dus phyis ci 'dra mchis: dus gsum mkhyen pa pad+ma rgyal po yis: 'gro la brtser dgongs bdag la gsung par zhu: zhes gu ru la zhus pa: ྈྈྈྈྈ gu rus gsungs pa: rgyal po la sogs bod 'bangs rnams legs par nyon la yid la zhog cig: da ste lo bzhi bcu zhe gcig nas 'di ltar rim pa bzhin 'byung bar 'gyur ro: zhes ma 'ongs lung bstan skabs bcu drug pa gsungs pas bod kyi rgyal blon thams cad shin tu sha g.ya' bar gyur to: der bod kyi rgyal blon thams cad blo dang 'dun pa gcig pas de lta bu'i dus byung tsa na 'gro ba bzhi cha grir 'gum par gda' bas: grir mi 'gum la gris mi tshugs pa'i gdams pa gcig gu ru rje la zhus pa legs so: zhes kha 'chams te mchod pa phul nas mgrin gcig tu zhus pa: e ma 'gro mgon pad+ma 'byung: ma 'ongs snyigs ma'i dus de ru: rang lus rdo rje ltar 'gyur zhing: bar chad rkyen gyis mi tshugs pa'i: yid bzhin nor bu lta bu yi: khyad par 'phags pa'i gdams ngag gcig: gsang ba thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas: gab pa'i gdams pa mngon phyung ste: 'gro la brtser dgongs bshad du gsol: zhes zhus pas: gu rus 'di skad ces bka' bstsal to: dus der dgongs pa'i gdams ngag gcig: rgyud sde kun gyi bcud phyung zhing:

pad+ma nga yi snying lta bu: gdams pa'i rgyal po mtshon srung 'di: phyi rabs don du bshad par bya: 'dzam gling nor bus gang ba bas: gdams pa 'di ka yid la chongs: snying gi dkyil du sa ma ya: sems la chongs shig tiṣ+ṭha lhan: zhes gsungs nas: mtshon srung ba'i gdams pa 'di gsungs so: mtshon srung gi lo rgyus rdzogs so: sa ma ya: ྈྈྈྈྈ ྈྈྈ ྈྈྈ rgya rgya rgya: ྈྈྈ ྈྈྈྈྈྈ ྈྈྈ ༈ rgya gar skad du: tik+ṣa rak+ṣa sarba tsakra u pa de sha nā ma: bod skad du: mtshon cha thams cad srung bar byed pa 'khor lo'i man ngag ces bya ba: bcom ldan 'das zhi khro rab 'byams kyi tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo: thabs mkhas thugs rje chos dbyings dag pa la: longs spyod rdzogs dang sprul sku'i 'od zer 'bar: myur mgyogs thugs rjes sdug bsngal tshogs skyob pa'i: rgyal sras sems dpar bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod: 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho sdug bsngal 'khrigs pa las: rtag par des gtses 'dug pa'i 'gro ba la: mi 'jigs mgon dang bde ldan dpung gyur pa'i: sra brtan mi 'gyur mtshon srung bstan par bya: phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas ma lus pa'i: sku yi byin rlabs gzi brjid ma lus pa: gcig tu dril ba'i mtshon srung 'di la ni: thog mar rnal 'byor dam tshig sdom par ldan: snying rje shes rab brtson 'grus ldan pa yis: 'du 'dzi spangs pa'i dben gnas yid 'thad par: mchod gtor brgyan bsham bdag nyid gang mos pa'i: lha yi bsnyen pa rim bzhin thems par bya: de nas dus dang skar ma bzang po rgyal la sogs/ la: byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed rab ldan pas: bde gshegs kun 'dus mtshon srung bri bar bya: mthing shog yul snyoms gru bzhi legs pa la: dbus btsal gser gyi thur mas mig phug la: sa bcu mtshon byed 'khor lo rim bcu bskor: tha mar me ri rdo rje tsha tsha bcas: gru bzhi sprul pa'i 'khor lo mchod rten bkod: 1) 'khor lo'i lte bar lte ba mthing kha/

thugs kyi rigs 'dus pa: rdo rje'i mtha' mar sngags kyi phreng bar dgod: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra ma hā sarba pheṃ pheṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi kā la baṃ sarba tīk+ṣ+ṇa sa ma ya: hrī hrī hrī: tad+ya thā: oṃ mu ni mu ni ma hā mu na ye swā hā: oṃ tīk+ṣ+ṇa lu ni ta ka ta ka ta ka: oṃ hrī ha yaṃ grī ba phaṭa: mtshon gtub sod mā ra ya phaṭa: 'chang ba la mtshon cha'i 'jigs pa thams cad srungs shig rak+ṣaḥrak+ṣaḥrak+ṣa: 2) phyi rim mu khyud dmar po/ la: thugs kyi lha mo'i rig pa 'di: sngags 'go phyir bstan 'god par bya: oṃ badz+ra kro tī shwa rī ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: oṃ ha ri ni sa hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ badz+ra ma hā sarba pad+ma kro tī shwa rī hūm̐ phaṭa: mtshon bcad do gtub bo: 'chang ba po la mtshon cha'i gnod pa thams cad srungs shig rak+ṣa: 3) mu khyud de'i phyi ma la: sku yi 'khor lo dkar po/ rtsibs bcu bri: rtsibs la 'di ltar sngags rnams 'god: mgo phyir bstan/ oṃ hūm̐ badz+ra kā ra sa ma ya duṣ+ṭān ma hā hrī du pa la ya hūm̐ phaṭa: ming 'di la mtshon gyi 'jigs pa srungs shig rak+ṣa: oṃ hūm̐ badz+ra bhigh+nān du sha ya sa ma ya hūm̐ hūm̐ hrī phaṭa: ming 'di la= oṃ hūm̐ badz+ra sa ma ya s+pho ṭa yaṃ s+pho ṭa yaṃ hūm̐ ha ha phaṭa: ming 'di la= oṃ hūm̐ badz+ra tīk+ṣ+ṇa ya sarba hriṃ ḍa hriṃ ḍa phaṭa: ming 'di la= oṃ hūm̐ badz+ra pa ta ya: ya s+pho ṭa badz+ra sa ma ya badz+ra phaṭa: ming 'di la= oṃ hūm̐ badz+ra ya mān+ta badz+ra kro ta ya hūm̐ phaṭa: ming 'di la= oṃ hūm̐ badz+ra tīk+ṣ+ṇa tīk+ṣ+ṇa sarba sa ma ya hrīng hrīng ha ha hūm̐ phaṭa: ming 'di la= oṃ hūm̐ badz+ra gṛh+ṇa badz+ra pre bhi sha ya phaṭa hūm̐ hūm̐ hrī ma hāṃ ka ru ga na hūm̐ phaṭa: ming 'di la= oṃ hūm̐ badz+ra dh+ri kā ba du ma sa ya mā ra ta ka ya he haṃ haṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: ming 'di la= oṃ hūm̐ badz+ra badz+ra a mṛta kun+ḍa lī sa ma ya ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa:

ming 'di la= rtsibs mchan bcu ser po/ la mtshon cha yi: ngar bcag pa'i sngags 'di ni: mgo phyir bstan la dgod pa'o: oṃ rnor zlog chom dril s+pha ra ṇa bh+yo zlog: oṃ rnor sod chom zlog s+pha ra ṇa bh+yo zlog: oṃ rnor chum mtshon dril s+pha ra ṇa bh+yo zlog: oṃ rnor sgyur chom sod dril s+pha ra ṇa bh+yo zlog: oṃ rnor gtubs chom nan s+pha ra ṇa bh+yo zlog: oṃ rnor shig chom sgyur s+pha ra ṇa bh+yo zlog: oṃ rnor nan chom nan chom sbud s+pha ra ṇa bh+yo zlog: oṃ rnor sbud chom shig s+pha ra ṇa bh+yo zlog: oṃ rnor phyung chom shig s+pha ra ṇa bh+yo zlog: oṃ rnor zlog sgyur chom sgyur s+pha ra ṇa bh+yo zlog: 4) mu khyud de'i phyi ma dmar po/ la: yig 'go nang bstan dmar po la: mtshon gyi bskal pa bshigs pa yi: ye shes chen po'i sngags 'di dgod: na mo rat+na tra yā ya: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrī: ka kha ga gha nga: tsa tsha dza dzha nya: ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa: ta tha da dha na: pa pha ba bha ma: ya ra la wa sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa: a ā: i ī: u ū: ṛ ṝ: l̥ l̥̄: e ai: o au: aṃ a: oṃ na ma sa man+ta badz+rā ṇāṃ: hūm̐ ya ma sha ri sa ma ya: mtshon cha gṛh+ṇa da ha da ha sarba pad+ma he ru ka sa ma ya: mtshon cha gtub gtub mā ra ya zlog rbad rbad rbud ya: oṃ ka la duṣ+ṭān ma ma ka tra ka tra bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: oṃ e waṃ sa ma ya mi li mi li su hūm̐ bhan+dha bhan+dha phaṭa: ma hā kha sho ya tri hūm̐ tri hūm̐ hūm̐: ming 'di zhes bya ba la mtshon gyi 'jigs pa thams cad srungs shig zlog cig rak+ṣa: rak+ṣa: 5) mu khyud de'i phyi ma ljang khu la/ la: drag po'i 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad bri: de la sra brtan sngags 'di dgod: oṃ sarba kro ta ni kā la du dun badz+ra badz+ra hūm̐: ming 'di la 'khor lo ltar bskor ba'i mtshon cha srungs shig rak+ṣa: oṃ sarba bhi tsa ya a pra ti ha ta badz+ra badz+ra hūm̐: ming 'di la me ltar sreg pa'i mtshon= oṃ bhud+dha sha ya ha sa kī li kī la badz+ra badz+ra hūm̐:

ming 'di la gsor ltar 'bugs pa'i mtshon= oṃ ha ya mu ma de du sa na hūm̐ phaṭa badz+ra badz+ra hūm̐: ming 'di la ri ltar gnon pa'i mtshon= oṃ druṃ bhan+dha bhan+dha ha la tīk+ṣ+ṇa tīk+ṣ+ṇa badz+ra badz+ra hūm̐: ming 'di la lcags sgrog ltar 'ching ba'i mtshon= oṃ dha ma dha ma ri ha sa na sha na phaṭa phaṭa badz+ra badz+ra hūm̐: ming 'di la thog ltar mgyogs pa'i mtshon= oṃ ni dzha la raṃ raṃ si ghe laṃ s+t+waṃ bha badz+ra badz+ra hūm̐: ming 'di la kha char ltar 'bab pa'i mtshon= oṃ badz+ra suṃ bh+rūm̐ pad+ma hrī ti badz+ra badz+ra hūm̐: ming 'di la rlung ltar g.yo ba'i mtshon cha srungs shig rak+ṣa: 'khor lo de yi rtsibs mchan la: mtshon gyi ngar bshig sngags 'di 'god: oṃ badz+ra tsag dus sha sarba rbad duṃ lha ma lhaṃ ltaṃ zer ba'ang 'dug/ mtshon cha mā ra ya sod sod: oṃ badz+ra ma hā ka tsa pa ye rbud rbud tser tser mtshon cha sarba zlog zlog: oṃ badz+ra kla du she bha ri shig shig ya ha mtshon cha sarba gtubs gtub: oṃ badz+ra du na gh+ri hā tāk+ṣi hūm̐ phaṭa mtshon cha sarba rbud rbud: oṃ badz+ra ma ṇi pa traṃ ya ma du raṃ trig shag mtshon cha sarba sgyur sgyur/ oṃ badz+ra k+ṣo pur tir thā mā ka bi ta hūm̐ mtshon cha sarba byer byer: oṃ badz+ra hu me hūm̐ hrī sarba gh+ri ti ṭa m-i ṇi phaṭa: mtshon cha thams cad a ba dengs dengs: oṃ badz+ra ghu ha tiṣ+ṭha saṃ bha raṃ du raṃ tshal pa ya mtshon cha sarba sa ma ya bh+yo zlog: 6) mu khyud de'i phyi rim ser po/ la: dus min 'chi ba brgyad zlog pa'i: rig pa'i sngags 'di bkod par bya: tad+ya thā: na mo shākya rā dzā ya oṃ sarba saṃska ri bud+dha ta thā ga ta sarba pheṃ pheṃ: na mo bha ga te a pa ri mi tāyur+dzñā na puṇ+ye puṇ+ye su bi nish+tsi ta te dzo rā dzā ya ma hā sarba puṇ+ye puṇ+ye ta thā ga tā ya tad+ya thā puṣ+ṭīṃ sarba pā shaṃ ku ru ye sarba sid+dhir+tha puṇ+ye oṃ sarba saṃska ri pa ri shud+dha dharma te ga ga na sa mut+ga te sarba ro pa tsit+ta ma ni hūm̐ sarba bi shud+dhe u pa gu ṇi puṇ+ye puṇ+ye sarba ro pa tsi ta swā hā:

ma hā nā ya pa ri dharma dhā tu ma hā pha la badz+ra ha se ha se swā hā: ming 'di zhes bya ba la dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba dang mtshon cha'i 'jigs pa thams cad srungs shig rak+ṣaḥrak+ṣaḥrak+ṣa: 7) mu khyud de yi phyi ma sna tshogs/ la: mtshon chas mtshon cha zlog byed pa'i: ye shes rno myur mtshon cha bri: rdo rje rtse lnga lte ba la: rwa dang lte ba hūm̐ phyir bstan/ bcas dang: mda' gzhu 'gengs dang ral gri yi: nang du shā traṃ ba shaṃ zer ba'ang snang*/ bris pa dang: 'khor lo zhags pa la sogs lcags sgrog gi: lte ba rtsibs logs phaṭa hrī bri: rtse gsum rgyal mtshan lcags kyu yi: logs la ma mak+ṣa gnas pa dang: rgyal mtshan zhing dbyug dgra s+t+wa la: thūṃ hrī muṃ hūm̐ zhes pa dang: me dang spu gri gtun shing la: phaṭa phaṭa nan nan zhes pa dang: gri so gcig pa ba dan dang: dbyug to khram shing logs dag la: bh+yo bh+yo rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ zhes dang: thog dang ri rab gri gug la: sa dun sha badz+ra nan: brag ri mchod rten sbrul zhags la: du du ma ma ki li kī li hūm̐: chu dang pad+ma thod khrag la: oṃ du ma pad+ma phaṭa: oṃ du hrī pad+ma badz+ra phaṭa phaṭa:zer ba'ang snang*/ bum pa dpag bsam nor bu la: sha kra k+ṣa ya zhes pa da nga: tri shul phub dang rlung nag la: phaṭa phaṭa hrī hrī badz+ra dang: ut+pal dung rtsang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga: hūm̐ k+ṣa badz+ra rak+ṣa'o: kun gyi bar du sngags 'di dgod: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ya ma hā sarba rnor sod chom dril mtshon cha zlog: 8) mu khyud de yi phyi ma dmar po/ la: rdo rje go cha'i sngags 'di bri: mgo nang bstan/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥsarba badz+ra du na sha ya hūm̐ phaṭa: badz+ra mi ti mi ti ha ra ha ra hūm̐ phaṭa: dha ra ya dha ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa: ts+tshin+da ts+tshin+da hūm̐ phaṭa: ṣ+ṭoṃ bhan+dha bhan+dha hūm̐ phaṭa: mā ra ya mā ra ya badz+ra pa kra pa kra badz+ra du naṃ badz+ra/ bhin+dha ya ma hūm̐ phaṭa: tad+ya thā: hūm̐ hrī mi ri ri ri ri: hūm̐ badz+ra sarba sha truṃ nan:

ka ra ka ra ka ra ka ra: s+pho ṭa sa ma hri: dha dha dha dha: sa ma ya: badz+ra badz+ra badz+ra badz+ra badz+ra badz+ra: rak+ṣa rak+ṣa: hūm̐ hūm̐ badz+ra nan hūm̐ hūm̐ ya ma badz+ra du na badz+ra k+ṣoṃ tra: tad+ya thā: sa ma ra tsa ya ma ha bhid kha gha du ya: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa: ming 'di la mtshon gyis phigs par ma gyur cig: mtshon gyi rtse blta bar ma gyur cig: ma hā badz+ra hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa rak+ṣa: mtshon gyi gnod pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: 9) mu khyud de yi phyi ma ser po/ la: mtshon gyis tshugs par mi 'gyur ba'i: bden pa'i stobs 'di bri bar bya: dmar po bri mgo phyir bstan 'di dam par bri/ na mo bud+dha ya na mo dharmā ya na mo saṃ ghā ya sarba ta thā ga ta ga tsa me: na mo sangs rgyas bden pa dang mthu dang gzi brjid kyis ming 'di zhes bya ba la mtshon gyis phigs par ma gyur cig: chos kyi bden pas mtshon zhi bar gyur cig: dge 'dun gyi bden pas mtshon zhi bar= 'khor lo'i rigs kyi bden pas mtshon= rdo rje'i rigs kyi bden pas mtshon= rin chen rigs kyi bden pas mtshon= pad+ma'i rigs kyi= las kyi rigs kyi= sku yi rigs kyi= gsung gi rigs kyi= thugs kyi rigs kyi= zhi ba'i lha'i rigs= khro bo'i rigs kyi lha'i bden pas= theg pa rim par ston pa rnams kyi mthu dang bden pas= bden par smra ba rnams kyi bden pas mtshon zhi bar gyur cig: mtshon gcad do: mtshon brtul lo: mtshon zlog sgyur sa ma ya: sa 'ur sa 'ur: phaṭa phaṭa: rak+ṣa rak+ṣa rak+ṣa: swā hā:

10) mu khyud de yi phyi ma dmar po/ la: mtshon chas mi shigs pa'i sngags: rdo rje sngon po/ drug cu re gcig la: lte bar hūm̐ dang rak+ṣa bri: rwa la mgo phyir bstan/ hūm̐ gnyis bsnol mar bri: rdo rje'i bar bar sngags 'di bri: oṃ sarba gri ya gri ya mtshon dril rbad chod swā hā: 'khor lo'i rgyab tu rgya gram rdo rje/ dang: oṃ āḥhūm̐: rten 'brel snying po bri: nang gi gru bzhi bang rim brgyad brtsegs/ bang rim bzhi man chad 'khor lo'i rtse mo yar bstan/ rtsibs ser/ mchan dmar/ bzhi man chad rtse mo mar bstan rtsibs dmar mchan sngo/ mdzes byed la tshon byed zer ba'ang 'dug go/ mchod rten la: oṃ mu ni mu ni badz+ra pā ṇi 'chang ba po la mtshon srungs shig rak+ṣa: 'khor lo mtshon rtsis kha dog dbye: rdo rjes ma reg pad+ma'i khrag: gtsod khrag sha ba pu shud khrag: gi waṃ gla rtsi kun la byug: khyi dang spre 'us bltar mi rung: mdze yugs nal mas reg mi rung: tshwa dang zwa dang lo ma dang: la phug sgog tsong reg mi rung: sngags la lhag chad med pa dang: mu khyud ma chad ma 'dres dang: shog gu bug rdol med par bya: dang po'i dkyil mig tshal gyis dgag: rab tu gser dngul 'bring du rin chen mtshal: tha ma rgya snag dri bzang ldan pas bri: de ltar 'khor lo legs bris nas: skar ma rgyal la babs pa dang: kha tshar ma nyams ras stengs su: 'bru dang rin chen bcal du bkram: sngags 'go shar bstan 'khor lo bkod: dar zab gur phub rgyal mtshan gzugs: dkar gtor dmar gtor cha lnga bsham: phyi nang mchod gtor gser skyems bsham: shar du gri bdun brdar la bzhag: lho ru mda' bdun gzhu bdungs bzhag: byang du mdung bdun gyen du slong: nub tu sngags pa bdag nyid 'dug: phyi nang yi dam gang mos kyi: mchod bstod legs par gzhung bsrang zhing: lha dang gzhi bdag legs par bcos: de nas gu gul dud pa dang: nyungs dkar rgyal po sngags ldan pas:

'khor lo'i bgegs bskrad bden pa brdar: de nas 'khor lo stong par bsgom: stong pa'i ngang las raṃ byung bas: ye shes me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus: hūm̐ las rdo rje'i rwa gur dang: oṃ las 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa: bh+rūm̐ las 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa: de yi lte bar nyi ma'i steng: khro chu'i rdo rje rtse lnga bsam: sngags kun gser gyi mdog tu bsgom: sngags las 'od zer 'phros pa yis: bskyed pa 'dra ba'i sems dpa' bstim: phyi nang mchod pa tshar gcig dbul: sngags las 'od zer yar 'phros pas: phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: sku gsung thugs kyi nus pa bkug: 'khor lo'i sngags la yang yang bstim: phyi nang mchod pa tshar gcig dbul: dbus kyi rdo rje gyur pa las: sku yi khro bo gshin rje gshed: smug nag 'khor lo ral gri 'dzin: dur khrod chas kyis brgyan pa yi: thugs kar gsung gi khro bo ni: rta mgrin dmar nag dbang gi sku: dbyug to pad+ma bsnams pa 'o: de yi thugs kar mkha' 'gro ni: bdud rtsi 'khyil ba ljang nag la: rgya gram gtun shing bsnams pa bsgom: de yi thugs kar gos sngon can: mthing nag rdo rje me dpung 'bar: kun kyang 'jigs tshul bstan par bsgom: de yi thugs kar rdo rje yi: lte bar hūm̐ dang sngags 'di bsam: oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa a mṛta ha yaṃ grī ba ya mān+ta ka hūm̐ hūm̐ hrīḥphaṭa: sngags las 'od byung ye shes bkug: rigs lngas dbang bskur ye shes ldan: sngags las 'od byung bdag la phog: ye shes me yis nyon mongs bsregs: mdun gyi lha tshogs ci 'dra bar: skad cig ma la bdag nyid gyur: dpa' bo yig 'bru nyi shu pa: brgya rtsa brjod la 'bru la bsngags: 'khor lo'i sngags rnams rim bzhin du: brgya rtsa re yis rab gnas bya: bsrung bya thugs ka'i rdo rje yi: lte bar gzi brjid ldan par bzhag: bden pa'i stobs kyis mthun 'gyur bya: de nas bsrung bya khrus nas phyung:

gu gul/ dud pas bdug cing bgegs bskrad la: mtshon gyi bskal pa zhi ba dang: 'gro ba'i 'jigs pa bskyab pa'i phyir: mtshon dbang zhu bar sems bskyed do: khro bo bzhi po bsgom du gzhug: khro bo'i snying po brgya rtsa bzlas: de nas 'khor lo dar gyis dril: mgo mjug ma log spyi bor bzhag: khyad par gzhan las 'phags pa'i chos: 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed po yis: khyed kyi lus kun bsrung bar bya: khro bo'i snying po lan bdun brjod: spyi bor gshin rje gshed po bsgom: de bzhin mgrin par rta mgrin te: snying khar bdud rtsi 'khyil ba las: rgyab tu phyag na rdo rje 'o: gzhan yang 'khor los lus bskor zhing: hūm̐ hūm̐ rak+ṣa zhes brjod pas: lus kun khro bo mi bzad pa: mthing nag rgya gram bsnams pa yis: khengs par ma yengs dmigs pa gtad: 'bring gis lha bzhi gsal bar bya: tha mas rang lus rdo rje la: ye shes me lnga 'bar bsams la: sngags rgod nyi shu brgya rtsa brgyad: slob dpon lha yi nga rgyal gyis: sha ba gtsod dang spyang ki dang: zhum bu nag po gang rung ba'i: rtug pa gang rnyed chang dang bsres: smra ba gcad la sngags 'di brgya: nyungs dkar la bsngags chang nang du: bskyur ba gdams ngag dam pa yin: oṃ gri ti gri srog la mā ra ya dza: dzaḥrbad rbad gtubs: zi ra thal chen nyungs nag la: brgya bsngags bsgrub bya'i lus la gtor: sngags 'chang bsgrub bya'i lus kun bkru bsang*/ dang: gri mda' mdung gi so la byug: mtshon gyi ngar chag kha nyal nas: mtshon gyi bskal pa nyams bsam ste: bdag dang bsrung bya gnyis ka yis: bden pa'i stobs rnams legs par brjod: bsrung bya'i lha la bka' bsgo bya: bdag dang bsrung bya gnyis ka yis: ma yengs rdo rje'i lte ba na: bsrung bya yod par brtan byas la: 'khor lo mgul nas ma 'chugs par: dpa' po nyi shu lnga brjod cing: rgyab nas mda' bdun brdeg par bya: mdun nas gri bdun brdeg par bya:

g.yas g.yon gnyis nas mda' mdung brdeg: mda' gri mdung sogs grangs 'dzom pas: sngags dang ldan pas brdeg byas la: hūm̐: dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang: skyob pa shākya seng ge yis: mi shigs rdo rje'i ting 'dzin la: rtse gcig bsam gtan gnas mdzad pas: ma rungs bdud kyi mtshon cha rnams: mdzes pa'i me tog rgyan du gyur: bdud kyi sde rigs pham byas nas: mtshon gyi bskal pa nyams par mdzad: de bzhin deng 'dir bu khyod la: sra brtan mtshon cha'i dbang bskur ro: oṃ na ma sarba gh+ri gri shun tse sha hūm̐ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa: zhes pas don snying dbang po dang: lhu tshigs lus kyi gnas kun du: mtshon cha sna tshogs 'debs par bya: de nas bkra shis legs par gsol: rtag tu 'khor lo lus la bcang: lha la gtang rag mchod gtor bya: bdag gi sems dpa' gnas su gshegs: bsgrub bya'i sems dpa' 'khor lo gnas: 'khor lo bde chen zhing du bsam: ji srid 'khor ba gnas kyi bar: 'di la srung zhes phrin las bcol: lo yi dus su 'khor lo la: rab gnas gso ba grub na dga': dge ba bsngo zhing smon lam gdab: bde gshegs rgyal ba 'dus pa yi: 'khor lo'i rgyal po 'di 'chang ba'i: mi la 'khor lo ral gri dang: mda' mdung tri shul s+t+wa gri dang: lcags sogs rin chen las gyur pa'i: mtshon cha kun gyis tshugs mi 'gyur: thog sogs skar mda' 'bab mi 'gyur: g.yang dang gtib grir 'chor mi 'gyur: rdo gri dbyer ma reg chod kyis: 'di yi lus la mi phigs shing: rtsang dang gtun shing tsher ma yis: 'di yi lus la phigs mi srid: lcags sgrog sdom dang zhags pa yis: 'di yi lus la sdom mi 'gyur: me dang rbod gtong phyogs ngan dang: gshed kyis 'di la tshugs mi 'gyur: dug dang chu ru mi 'gum la: rims dang gza' gdon 'bab mi 'gyur: sde brgyad kun gyis mi mthong zhing: 'go ba'i lha rnams rab tu byams: tshe ring dpal 'byor gzi brjid che:

kun gyis yid du bu bzhin 'ong: bud med rnams la btags gyur na: rtag par mngal du bu pho chags: rgyal ba kun gyis dgongs par mdzad: rtag tu bar chad med par 'gyur: mdze pho yugs sa nal ma yis: mi reg mi 'gom dam tshig ste: de rnams kun la 'dog pa na: 'khor lo gu gul nag pos byug: gnad kyi gdams ngag dam pa 'o: 'di yi rdzas mchog rak+ta ni: bcu gsum man chad bu mo chu yi khams: mi srid byung yang nus pa yod ma yin: nyer lnga yan chad rgan mo shing gi khams: mi reg srid kyang yid tsam nus pa chung: bcu gsum nyer lnga'i bar gyi lo bcu gsum: gang byung dar ma me lcags dril ba'i khams: nus mthu dpag med rdo rje pha lam rdzas: gang zhig ma rnyed khyim bya'i ze ba dang: khrag dang zer ba'ang 'dug / ga pur bu ram cha mnyam g.yer ma rnams: chang sbyar btang bas don de 'grub par 'gyur: mdog ni dmar ser yid tsam bgrod pa la: rgya sol mer bsregs tsha bzhin 'phar ba dang: mi 'chi gzhom med mchog gi rdzas su bshad: rgyal blon 'khor bcas thugs la 'di dgongs la: da lta mi 'chal spel ba'i gnas med pas: phyi rabs don du rin chen gter du sbos: pad+ma nga yi smon lam mthu btsan pas: las can gcig dang myur du 'di 'phrad shog: phyi rabs rme 'khrug mtshon cha dar ba'i tshe: ti se'i rtse la yul khams mthong rgya che ba'i ri rtse gang yang rung*/ 'khor lo 'di bcangs nas: dge slong brgya yis dmod pa bor gyur na: 'dzam gling 'di ru mtshon 'khrug yong mi srid: ces gsungs pas: rgyal blon bod 'bangs thams cad rab tu dga' ste: gu rus gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do: bde gshegs 'dus pa'i mtshon srung rdo rje'i go cha rdzogs so: rgya gar gyi mkhan po pad+ma 'byung gnas dang: bod kyi lo tsā ba nam mkha'i snying po dang: bai ro tsa nas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o: ldan ma rtse mang gis yi ger bkod de mnga' bdag la phul lo:

zab rgya: sbas rgya: gtad rgya: gter rgya: sa ma yā: rgya rgya rgya: gu h+ye: sa ma yā: rgya rgya rgya: shākya'i dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa tshe brtan rgyal mtshan gyis mon chu phug mo nas bton pa'o/ khyad 'phags shog dril gcig lags so// snod dang mi ldan pa la sa ma ya/ rgya rgya rgya/// /
